cause_definitions.no_crossing_in_6h: No finite q(t) ≥ τ for any t in [onset, onset+6h] (inclusive).
cause_definitions.preonset_active_block: Some episode has notify_idx < onset ≤ end_idx (notifier still active at onset), and no episode has notify_idx in [onset, onset+6h].
cause_definitions.confirmation_not_met: Reserved: this supervised notifier has no separate confirmation dwell beyond first q≥τ while inactive — always false for this pipeline.
cause_definitions.warmup_missingness: Onset index < feature warm-up, or every score in the credit window is non-finite, or >50% of credit-window scores are non-finite.

label_phase_encoding.note: Positives are always the first 6 h after leak_start on a 48 h trajectory with leaks drawn uniformly in [14 h, 38 h]. Absolute operating features can correlate with scenario clock time / diurnal phase.

control_burden_denominator.disclosure: Each control contributes only 48 h (0.2857 weeks). With few controls, ep/wk is a noisy rate over a short simulated denominator — not a year-scale burden estimate.

signal_summary.note: Ground-truth onset defines leak pre/post windows for description only. Control windows are clock-based (16 h and 24 h), not paired scenarios.

decision.label: Mixed or unresolved
evidence: 5/8 misses have no q≥τ in the 6 h credit window (insufficient score response at frozen τ).
5/8 misses are pre-onset-active blocked (notifier state prevents a new credit-window notify).
3 scenarios have row-credit hits but episode-6h misses (objective/notifier mismatch with row labels).
14 pre-onset notifies cluster at indices ~199 (~16.6 h scenario time) across leaks — shared operating/phase cue.
Synthetic_test controls alone yield 5.25 ep/wk under the same freeze — false episodes without leaks.
decision.recommended_next_intervention: Single next step: on synthetic DEV only, add an explicit preonset_active_block / inactive-at-onset constraint to the existing episode-selection gates (same C/τ budget; no post-hoc expansion), because the dominant miss pattern is a shared ~16.6 h operating-phase latch that also fires on controls and then blocks onset credit. Scenario-clock redesign is the alternate if gating cannot find any passing candidate. Do not implement in this audit.
